obj.cause: The default list is created once when the function is defined, so calls that omit xs share the same list and previous appends remain.
obj.change: Use None as the default for xs, then create a new empty list inside the function when xs is None.
obj.verification: After the change, append_item(1) returns [1] and a separate append_item(2) call returns [2], so the failing assertion passes.
